note: User-facing copy for each response pattern (PRD EC-F04-01 to EC-F04-05). Product owns this file; every change changes config_hash.

emergency.message: If this is an emergency, call your local emergency number or poison control now.

personal_advice.message: I can't advise on a specific person's treatment. Here is what the label says, quoted. The prescriber can decide what's right for this person.

out_of_scope.message: I only answer from one drug's label at a time, and I don't compare treatments or diagnose. Here is what this label says it is indicated for.

label_silent.message: The label doesn't address this. Absence from the label is not evidence of safety.
label_silent.askHuman: A pharmacist, or the manufacturer's medical information line

low_confidence.message: I'm not sure which part of the label answers this.
